title: Evaluation and biduality compatibility for fixed site-duality comparisons
statement:
Let $C$ be a Grothendieck abelian closed symmetric monoidal coefficient category with additive tensor product and functorial flat resolutions. For a scheme $X$, use the ordinary etale and pro-etale derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories, def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules], and suppose comparison inverse image preserves flat objects. Write $F=\nu_X^*$ for exact derived comparison [def-sf-comparison-derived-pullback], with canonical tensor comparison $c_{U,V}:F(U\otimes^LV)\cong FU\otimes^LFV$ and evaluation-defined internal-Hom comparison $a_{K,W}:FR\mathcal Hom(K,W)\to R\mathcal Hom(FK,FW)$ [def-sf-evaluation-hom-site-comparison]. Fix objects $W$ and $W'$ on the two sites and an isomorphism $w:FW\cong W'$. Put $D=R\mathcal Hom(-,W)$ and $D'=R\mathcal Hom(-,W')$ [def-pur-derived-internal-hom]. Fix normalized ambient duality pairings on both sites, so evaluation is the canonical tensor-Hom counit with the signed symmetry and $\delta$ is its double-dual transpose [lem-weil-duality-pairing].

For any etale derived object $K$, define finite-duality compatibility to mean that there exist isomorphisms $\chi_K:FDK\cong D'FK$ and $\chi_{DK}:FDDK\cong D'FDK$ whose homs are, respectively, $R\mathcal Hom(FK,w)\circ a_{K,W}$ and $R\mathcal Hom(FDK,w)\circ a_{DK,W}$, and which satisfy both
$${\rm ev}'_{FK}\circ(\chi_K\otimes1)=w\circ F({\rm ev}_K)\circ c_{DK,K}^{-1},$$
$$D'(\chi_K^{-1})\circ\chi_{DK}\circ F(\delta_K)=\delta'_{FK}.$$
The first equation has source $FDK\otimes^LFK$; the second has source $FK$ and target $D'D'FK$. This is a compatibility predicate with normalized comparison arrows. It imposes no constructibility or Tor hypothesis, and makes no assertion that it holds for all $K$.
